notices.text: Node 22 or later is now required and Node 26 is the tested target. better-sqlite3 v13 is the first release built on N-API, and its engines range sets the floor. nvm is the recommended way to manage this.

npm 12, which ships with Node 26, will not run dependency install scripts unless the package is allowlisted. package.json approves bcrypt, node-pty, @serialport/bindings-cpp and better-sqlite3, pinned to version. Without the allowlist, password hashing, door games and DOS doors over socat fail at runtime rather than at install time.

allow_netmail_relay is deprecated and ignored. Relay is now netmail_relay_mode, taking off, nodelist or on, and every upgrade lands on nodelist regardless of what the old boolean said. Read docs/sysop/NETMAIL_RELAY.md before choosing on, which is considerably broader than it reads.
Upgrading the host OS: read docs/sysop/OS_UPGRADE.md first. An Ubuntu release upgrade installs a new PostgreSQL major but does not migrate the data, and can silently remove build-essential.
